mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID=U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID=UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID=#{userId} AND U.ENABLED='Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE='DB_APPROVER' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM DUAL
mapper.sql:
WHERE R.APPROVAL_STATUS='APPROVED' AND R.REQUEST_STATUS IN ('READY','RUNNING')
AND (INSTR(UPPER(R.REQUEST_NO), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(UPPER(R.TITLE), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(UPPER(U.USER_NAME), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID=R.DRAFTER_ID

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, U.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.SUBMITTED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID=R.REQUEST_ID) AS QUERY_COUNT, B.BATCH_ID, B.BATCH_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID=R.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID=R.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.REQUEST_ID=R.REQUEST_ID AND B.BATCH_TYPE='INITIAL'
ORDER BY R.SUBMITTED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, R.REQUEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, U.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.SUBMITTED_AT, B.BATCH_ID, B.BATCH_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID=R.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID=R.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.REQUEST_ID=R.REQUEST_ID AND B.BATCH_TYPE='INITIAL' WHERE R.REQUEST_ID=#{requestId} AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS='APPROVED'

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, E.EXECUTION_ID, E.STATUS AS EXECUTION_STATUS, E.STARTED_AT, E.FINISHED_AT, E.ERROR_MESSAGE FROM QUERY_ITEM I LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.REQUEST_ID=I.REQUEST_ID AND B.BATCH_TYPE='INITIAL' LEFT JOIN QUERY_EXECUTION E ON E.BATCH_ID=B.BATCH_ID AND E.QUERY_ID=I.QUERY_ID WHERE I.REQUEST_ID=#{requestId} ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_ID
